svg.title: Digital Top and native circuit details, landscape composition
svg.desc: Landscape rearrangement of the supplied Genus figure. Every original native circuit image is reused without cropping, recoloring or geometric distortion. Native source positions determine the overview frames. Frames are overlapping bounding extents, not physical partitions; detail images show corresponding functional instances, not literal pixel crops of the overview. No schematic or design modification. Labels, frames and connectors are editable SVG vectors.
